Caveat: that first jump faded - YoY fell below 50% from Aug-2025 (Sep-25 +9.7%, Dec-25 -6.5%, Feb-26 1,913.16 vs 1,339 = +42.9%) and re-crossed with Mar-26 1,940.07 vs 1,228.17 = +58.0% (statement filed 08-Apr-2026). No Sep-23/Dec-23 figure was found in exchange filings (pre-IPO RHP not read), so Sep-24 1,192 and Dec-24 1,393.7 could not be tested. Monthly totals include zero-balance power-PPA lines and exclude L1 orders (Rs 391 cr L1 noted in Jan-2026).
